en.headline: Chiikawa Mid-Autumn lantern display opens today at AIRSIDE
en.dek: The free pop-up turns popular characters into traditional lanterns and runs until 4 October, with a reconstructed carousel photo spot for fans.
body: A Chiikawa-themed Mid-Autumn lantern display opens today at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak, running until 4 October as part of seasonal festivities.

The free event features the popular characters Chiikawa, Hachiware and Usagi transformed into accordion-paper, goldfish and rabbit lanterns. A reconstructed two-dimensional Chiikawa carousel photo installation is also on site.
Opening hours are 2 pm to 9 pm on 21 September (last entry 8.45 pm), then noon to 9 pm daily until 3 October, and noon to 8 pm on 4 October. Admission is free after 26 September.

The display sits on the second-floor atrium and at shops L210 and L222. It joins other Mid-Autumn events across the city, including the International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park and the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance later this week.

zh.headline: CHIIKAWA中秋燈會今日啟德AIRSIDE開鑼
zh.dek: 人氣角色化身風琴紙、金魚及兔仔燈籠，免費展覽即日至10月4日舉行，並設迴旋木馬打卡位。
body: CHIIKAWA主題中秋燈會今日於啟德AIRSIDE揭幕，展覽持續至10月4日。
活動免費入場，將吉伊卡哇、小八及兔兔化身為風琴紙燈籠、金魚燈籠及兔仔燈籠，現場並重建2D《CHIIKAWA迴旋木馬》打卡位。
9月21日開放時間為下午2時至9時（最晚入場8時45分），其後每日中午12時至晚上9時，10月4日則至晚上8時。9月26日起免費入場。
展覽位於2樓中庭及L210、L222舖位，與維園國際中秋綵燈匯及大坑舞火龍等其他中秋活動同期舉行。
